title: Add plugin source line-budget guard
description: Create a reproducible guard that reports authored plugin files outside the accepted 200 to 400 line range before more Filter Controller work lands.
objective: Make file-size drift visible during verification instead of discovering 1200+ line files after bugs appear.
expected_outputs: Budget exceptions list for generated/vendor/temporary files and tracked transition debt
Verification command added to the Filter Controller QA routine: php scripts/verify-line-budget.php --strict
acceptance_criteria: Authored plugin PHP/CSS/JS files above 400 lines are reported.
Files above 450 lines block new feature work unless a split task is active.
Generated/vendor files are not falsely treated as authored source.
The guard is documented in task verification output.
risks: A blunt line-count guard can block legitimate generated files if exceptions are not explicit.
A warning-only guard will not change behavior unless future tasks treat it as a gate.
